safetyTips: Always have an adult present. Children must be supervised at all times.
Use crackers only in open spaces, away from buildings, vehicles and dry grass.
Keep a bucket of water or sand nearby.
Light at arm's length and step back immediately. Never lean over a cracker.
Never try to relight a cracker that did not go off. Soak it in water.
Wear cotton clothes and footwear. Avoid loose synthetic clothing.
Follow the timings and rules set by local authorities.
